usage: 17592186124674.py [-h] [--difficulty {easy,moderate,hard,all}]
                         [--seed SEED] [--count COUNT]
                         [--format {markdown,json}] [--template TEMPLATE]
                         [--profile PROFILE]

Modeling Inhibited Growth — exact, bounded equation-construction generators.
Read-only math basis 1356. Source masks and complete banks are extracted in
the private evidence directory; no literal-question replay branch or answer
lookup. Observed scalar ratios are opaque evidence profiles, NOT inferred
misconceptions. Normal easy uses competing capacities and mixed
operation/capacity banks; moderate and hard are authored coefficient-placement
banks. All levels ask only to construct an ODE. The rational hard catalog is
finite, reduced, positive and bounded, including on explicit calls. Stable
content identities include the full displayed bank, fixed solution and prompt;
mathematical fingerprints exclude bank, context aliases and irrelevant initial
stocks. API/CLI are review artifacts, never EDB transactions.

usage: 17592186078583.py [-h] [--difficulty {easy,moderate,all}] [--seed SEED]
                         [--count COUNT] [--format {markdown,json}]
                         [--template TEMPLATE] [--profile PROFILE]

Newton cooling model setup, math source basis 2710. Easy and moderate preserve
the observed supplied givens, five-option radio layout and generic/substituted
two-stage solution. Hard is unsupported: the historical authored extra-reading
extension changes supplied information. Raw source profiles are replay-only
and retain source defects; normal output retains easy banks and uses
documented mixed-source moderate practice banks. The oil duplicate repair and
TeX/context corrections remain. No ODE solving. Task fingerprints exclude
initial reading, context, seed and choice ordering.

Solving an inhibited decay model: source-faithful radios and authored hard
radios. No EDB writes. The observed scalar profiles preserve rounded offsets
only; they are explicitly opt-in evidence profiles and do not claim recovered
error intent. Default banks sample nearby integer errors with variable numeric
ranks, without restricting valid IVPs to accommodate fixed misconception
recipes.
